caption:
Atomberg is gearing up for its IPO with a massive 150 crore rupee marketing budget in hand. When your fans are doing well, why not let the entire country know about them? Time to see some very serious fan ads everywhere we look. 

What brand do you think has the best ads right now?

Source: BMI

#Atomberg #IPO #MarketingStrategy #Branding #StartupIndia

post.news: Fan maker Atomberg just got approval for its IPO and set aside 150 crore rupees just for branding and marketing.
post.take: That is a lot of money to make sure your ceiling fan is the main character in your room.
post.insight: When hardware brands hit scale, they stop selling specs and start selling a lifestyle.
